title: Pure Cataclysmic
summary: The four Level 8 Attribute-specific Cataclysmic Fairy monsters (FIRE, WATER, WIND, and EARTH) paired with self-destruction starters (Fire King Avatar Arvata and Unchained Twins - Aruha), Supply Squad, Trade-In, Torrential Tribute, and Rank 8 Xyz bosses. Whenever a monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect, the matching Cataclysmic Fairy drops from the hand with 2600 ATK and an Attribute-specific bonus effect.

summary.title: Starters & Self-Destruction Triggers
points: Fire King Avatar Arvata negates any monster effect activation as a Quick Effect and destroys another FIRE monster in your hand or on your field, immediately triggering Cataclysmic Scorching Sunburner in the hand.

Unchained Twins - Aruha destroys 1 face-up card you control to Special Summon itself from the hand; destroying a FIRE, WATER, WIND, or EARTH monster you control triggers the matching Cataclysmic Fairy in your hand.
Trade-In discards any of the twelve Level 8 Cataclysmic monsters in the Main Deck to draw 2 cards, digging into Supply Squad, Arvata, or Torrential Tribute.

summary.title: Opening: Fire King Avatar Arvata + Cataclysmic Fairy
steps: Activate Supply Squad if available, then Normal Summon Fire King Avatar Arvata (or a monster matching a Cataclysmic Fairy in your hand).

Trigger Arvata's destruction effect (or destroy your monster via Torrential Tribute); Supply Squad draws 1 card while the matching Cataclysmic Fairy Special Summons itself from the hand and resolves its bonus effect.
With two Level 8 Cataclysmic monsters on the field, Xyz Summon Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy or Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star, and Set Torrential Tribute.

summary.title: The Four Cataclysmic Fairies
summary.text: Each Level 8 Cataclysmic Fairy has 2600 ATK / 200 DEF and Special Summons itself from the hand when a face-up monster of its Attribute you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect—or by your own card effect, which also unlocks its secondary effect: Cataclysmic Scorching Sunburner (FIRE) burns the opponent for half the original ATK of one of the destroyed FIRE monsters in the GY; Cataclysmic Circumpolar Chilblainia (WATER) sends 1 random card from the opponent's hand to the GY; Cataclysmic Cryonic Coldo (WIND) places 1 Spell/Trap the opponent controls on top of their Deck; and Cataclysmic Crusted Calcifida (EARTH) sends 1 monster from your Deck to the GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star sends an opposing card to the GY without targeting on summon and detaches a material to protect your monsters from destruction.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy negates a Spell effect on the field and attaches it as Xyz Material, while redirecting attacks onto itself.
Coach King Giantrainer (made with 3 Level 8 Cataclysmic monsters) detaches up to 3 materials to draw up to 3 cards and burn the opponent for 800 LP per revealed monster.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Torrential Tribute destroys all monsters on the field when a monster is summoned, wiping the opponent's board while triggering your Supply Squad draw and replacing your destroyed monsters with Cataclysmic Fairies from your hand.
Supply Squad draws 1 card once per turn (including on the opponent's turn) whenever a monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect.
